log.note: N3 built: src/components/DropTarget.tsx, drop-target.css, dropTarget.test.ts (new files only, not wired; N4 wires). API: DropTarget({accept, onFiles, label, onReject?, children}); accept gets {name,size,type}. Window dragenter/dragleave depth counter shows a 1px --accent outline on the region plus a one-line label (data-state accept; reject uses --danger outline and the reason as label); no page tint, no transitions, square corners. button.select-files opens a hidden input[type=file] (multiple) as the keyboard path; picked or dropped files go through accept again and call onFiles or onReject(reason). Browser: onFiles gets File[]; browsers hide names and sizes during a drag, so accept is first called with name empty, size 0 and the MIME type, and must tolerate an empty name (decide on type or let through); the real check runs on drop/pick. Native: Tauri onDragDropEvent from the webview (imported dynamically, only when __TAURI_INTERNALS__ exists) gives paths; accept is called with {name: basename, size: 0, type: ""} so size checks are skipped; a drop counts only if its position (physical px / devicePixelRatio) is inside the region; onFiles gets string[] paths (read with readDroppedPath). N4 note: native listener is per DropTarget, so each registers its own; the ProjectLibrary listenForNativeDrops plumbing should be removed when it is replaced by DropTarget to avoid double handling. VERIFIED how far: tsc 0 errors; dropTarget.test.ts 6 pass (pure reducer/verdict/itemsFromTransfer/itemsFromPaths + SSR markup of Select files); fail-first: mutating verdict reject branch made 1 test fail, restored byte-identical (cmp via saved copy); src/motion.test.ts, designTokens.test.ts, palette.test.ts pass with the new CSS. NOT run: full npm test (serial slot held by T131 for 20+ minutes, could not register it), no browser/native rendering of the outline, native Tauri drop position unverified. DESIGN DOC: Drop target: the region that will take a file (DropTarget) gets a 1 px --accent outline (inset) and a one-line --type-small label only while a file drag is over the window; refused items turn the outline --danger and the label becomes the reason; no page tint, no motion. A Select files text button (muted, text on hover) is the keyboard path. In the Mac app drops arrive as paths and only count inside the region.
